subject: Forecast-linked rebate structure proposal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@pilotai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Forecast-linked rebate structure proposal

Hi Sana — great to talk this morning. Quick recap and a request so we can draft a tailored rebate term sheet for PilotAI:

1) Goal: you mentioned wanting to anchor unit economics near $900 / 1M tokens (target blended for embeddings + generations). Confirming that is still the right target.
2) Volumes: we discussed a 6–18 month ramp; please fill the attached forecast with month-by-month estimated token consumption (separate lines for embeddings and generations).
3) Budget: you indicated a $120k–$250k spend window for the next 12 months as a likely range. If that shifts materially let us know.
4) Incentives: two paths we can propose — a forecast-linked rebate (rebate % increases at volume thresholds) or a committed-use structure (flat lower $/1M in exchange for a minimum spend). Both can be multi-year.

Attached: pilotai-forecast-2026-2028.xlsx (forecast template), redwood-rebate-term-sheet-v1.pdf (example structure).

Next steps: can you return the completed forecast by Wed EOD (Dec 2)? If helpful, Ben and I can join a short follow-up to align thresholds with your finance team.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sana Patel <sana@pilotai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: PilotAI Procurement <procurement@pilotai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast-linked rebate structure proposal

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap and the templates. We're looping in finance/procurement here. A few clarifications from our side:

- Target: $900 / 1M tokens is a reasonable blended target for us to plan to; we can tolerate a +/-15% swing depending on model mix.
- Forecast: attached is a preliminary monthly forecast (Q4 2026 through Q4 2027) — it has a conservative, base, and upside row. You'll see embeddings are ~20% of total tokens initially, but we expect that to grow.
- Multi-year: leadership is open to a 2-year cadence if there are clear ramp protections. Their ask: make sure downside protection exists (minimum performance SLA + cap on rebates if usage drops).

Two questions for your team before we finalize the file: 1) what rebate levels map to the thresholds in your sample term sheet (I want to show finance explicit $/1M equivalents), and 2) do you offer any onboarding credits or usage credits tied to integrations?

Attaching our spreadsheet: PilotAI_forecast_filled.xlsx (attached). We'll plan to get you the signed NDA for the term sheet later this week.

Thanks,
Sana Patel
Head of Business Operations, PilotAI
sana@pilotai.com
[Attachment: PilotAI_forecast_filled.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@pilotai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast-linked rebate structure proposal

Hi Sana — looping in a quick sketch of numbers so finance has explicit $/1M comparisons (converted from our sample rebate sheet):

- Base list: $1,300 / 1M tokens (no commitment)
- Forecast-linked path (example):
  - 0–10M tokens / month: $1,200 / 1M (5% rebate)
  - 10–30M tokens / month: $980 / 1M (25% rebate)
  - 30M+ tokens / month: $820 / 1M (37% rebate)
- Committed-use example (12mo): 20% off list in exchange for a 12mo minimum of $150k (paid monthly or prepaid). Deeper tiers at 24mo with step-down to ~$750 / 1M depending on guaranteed volume.

Notes: those are illustrative — final thresholds can be tuned to your ramp profile. We typically include a ramp protection clause (rebate true-up vs. forecast) and a usage floor so finance doesn't over-forecast then hold us to retentions.

Would you be available Wed Dec 2 at 11:00 AM PT for a 30-minute aligner with procurement and finance? If that works, Karthik will send calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Ben Carter
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0138

Ben / Karthik — Wed Dec 2 at 11:00 AM PT works for us. Agenda items: 1) map your tiers to our forecast (we'll walk through the sheet), 2) confirm minimums and ramp protections, 3) onboarding credits and legal next steps.

Finance has penciled in a $140k–$220k 12-month commit they can consider for a committed-use path; they'll want a conservative carry-forward mechanism in case of under-usage. I'll bring the procurement lead to the call.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please send the invite.

—Sana
